task: Convert /home/user/Documents/colorful.png to grayscale and export to /home/user/Documents/colorful_gray.png.
task_grounding: Open the image /home/user/Documents/colorful.png in GIMP. Convert the image to grayscale mode (Image > Mode > Grayscale). Then export the grayscale image as /home/user/Documents/colorful_gray.png.

verification.description: Output grayscale PNG file exists at /home/user/Documents/colorful_gray.png
Output image is in grayscale (L) mode

cli_feasibility.translation: Use ImageMagick: convert input.png -colorspace Gray output.png
